description: Source file implementing the PlayerInfo plugin class, handling initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and codec information retrieval for a media player.

classes.name: PlayerInfo

methods.description: Initializes the PlayerInfo plugin, setting up player properties and codecs.

methods.name: Deinitialize
